title: Email can serve as the Beacon contact identity
body: Beacon could use email address as the authoritative contact identity across brands.

attributes.what_was_tried: Beacon used email address as the contact identity during the initial implementation.
attributes.why_it_failed: The email-based identity model caused incorrect identity handling and required a 3.23M-record re-import.
attributes.would_reconsider_if: Email could be demonstrated to provide a stable, globally safe identity independent of brand and contact lifecycle.
